roles.summary: Waiters and waitresses serve food and beverages across main dining rooms and specialty restaurants on cruise ships. The role demands fine dining service skills, product knowledge of food and wine, POS proficiency, and the ability to upsell. Experience in 4- or 5-star establishments is consistently expected, with at least one year of cruise ship experience valued highly.
experienceRequirements: 2–3 years minimum in a 4- or 5-star restaurant or hotel dining room
Minimum 1 year cruise ship waiter experience (Princess, Royal Caribbean)
Fine dining, silver service, or specialty dining experience preferred
Proven upselling track record
POS system operation (various brands)
Food and beverage menu knowledge including wine and cocktails
cvExpectations: List each venue by name with star rating and years worked
Include cruise ship contracts with ship name, company, and duration
Specify wine, sommelier, or cocktail training
Note any POS systems used (e.g., Micros, Squirrel, MedallionClass)
List any food safety / HACCP certifications
Include ISF Marlins Test result if applicable (Royal Caribbean requires Level 2)
Mention languages spoken and proficiency level
certifications: ISF Marlins Test Level 2 (Royal Caribbean requirement)
Seaman's Discharge Book / ENG1 Medical (for contract boarding)
C1/D US Visa (for ships calling US ports)
roles.languages: English (essential, fluent); additional languages (Italian, French, German, Spanish, Mandarin) strongly advantageous

roles.summary: Buffet Attendants maintain buffet stations throughout all meal services on cruise ships — replenishing food, monitoring presentation, cleaning stations, and assisting guests. The role is physically demanding and requires food safety knowledge. Entry-level relative to waiter roles but directly guest-facing.
experienceRequirements: Experience as a buffet attendant, cafeteria assistant, or food service worker
Cruise ship or high-volume food service experience preferred
Knowledge of food safety and sanitation standards
Physical stamina (long standing hours, heavy lifting)
Multitasking ability during busy service periods
cvExpectations: List food service and buffet experience with venue names and duration
Include food safety/hygiene certificate
Highlight cruise ship experience if held
Note physical fitness and ability to work long hours on feet
Mention English communication skills
certifications: STCW Basic Safety Training (required for cruise ship boarding)
roles.languages: English (fluent required); additional languages advantageous on multilingual ships

roles.summary: Bartenders and bar servers prepare and serve alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages in multiple bar venues across the ship. The role emphasises product knowledge, salesmanship and upselling, compliance with responsible alcohol service standards, and delivery of brand-specific bar experiences. Luxury lines expect mixology and specialist spirit expertise.
experienceRequirements: 2+ years bartending in a 4/5-star hotel, premium bar, or cruise ship
Cocktail preparation and mixology skills
Knowledge of wine, spirits, and beer (premium brands expected)
Responsible alcohol service compliance
Upselling and revenue target experience
Ability to set up and break down bar stations
Training junior bar staff (for senior roles)
cvExpectations: List bar venues and positions held with years of experience
Note luxury or premium brands worked with
Include ServSafe Alcohol Service or equivalent certification
Mention HACCP certificate (Explora Journeys requires it)
Highlight any mixology courses, whiskey qualifications, or sommelier study
Note upselling achievements or incentive program participation
Include POS / MICROS system experience
certifications: ServSafe Responsible Service of Alcohol (or WSET / local equivalent)
roles.languages: English (required, fluent); additional languages advantageous for bar service

roles.summary: Cabin Stewards service passenger staterooms and suites daily — cleaning, making beds, replenishing amenities, and handling guest requests. They are the most guest-proximate housekeeping role on the ship. Entry-level positions exist as trainee roles; experienced stewards are expected to manage an allotment of 15–20 cabins per shift.
experienceRequirements: Prior hotel or housekeeping experience (minimum for trainee roles)
Familiarity with 5-star room cleaning standards
Physical stamina for back-to-back cabin turnovers
Attention to detail for presentation and amenity placement
Guest interaction and communication skills
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
cvExpectations: List hotel or hospitality employer names with duration
Highlight star rating of hotels worked in
Note English language proficiency level (CEFR B1 minimum for Viking)
Include any housekeeping training or courses
Mention physical fitness and ability to work long hours
Note professional appearance (some lines specify no visible tattoos)
roles.languages: English (minimum B1/working level); additional languages strongly advantageous

roles.summary: Galley Stewards maintain cleanliness of all food preparation areas, dishwash equipment and galley surfaces in compliance with USPH standards. The role also encompasses chemical inventory management, waste segregation, and provisioning support. Senior Galley Stewards may supervise a team.
experienceRequirements: Kitchen steward or dishwasher experience in restaurant, hotel, or cruise ship
Knowledge of USPH sanitation and cleaning standards
Experience with industrial dishwashing equipment
Chemical handling and COSHH awareness
MARPOL/environmental waste compliance (cruise-specific)
Supervisory experience (for Head Galley Steward roles)
cvExpectations: List kitchen and galley workplaces with type and volume of operation
Include any USPH or HACCP knowledge/training
Note experience with chemical inventory or COSHH
Highlight cruise ship experience if held
Mention any supervisory or team lead roles
roles.languages: English (required for USPH documentation and instruction-following)

roles.summary: Commis Chefs assist senior chefs in preparing and cooking menu items across multiple galley stations. Cruise ships operate industrial-scale kitchens (galleys) feeding thousands daily. The role demands foundational cooking skills, strict adherence to sanitation protocols, and adaptability across cuisine stations.
experienceRequirements: Previous professional kitchen experience (hotel, restaurant, or catering)
Knowledge of basic cooking techniques across multiple cuisines
Strict sanitation and food hygiene practice
Experience in high-volume kitchen environments
Ability to follow recipes and portion guidelines
Passion for culinary arts and desire to progress
cvExpectations: List culinary training institutions and qualifications
Include names of kitchens and types of cuisine
Note any HACCP or Food Handlers Certificate
Highlight any cruise ship galley experience
Mention any specialisations (pastry, grill, cold larder, etc.)
roles.languages: English (working level required for galley communication)

roles.summary: Guest Services Agents are the primary contact point for passengers at the ship's reception — handling check-in/out, billing disputes, currency exchange, shore excursion bookings, and complaints. Luxury lines (Explora Journeys) require PMS system knowledge (Fidelio/Otalio) and multiple European languages.
experienceRequirements: Hotel front desk or receptionist experience
Luxury or premium hospitality background (Explora Journeys requirement)
Fidelio or Otalio Cruise Management System knowledge (valued highly)
Cash handling and billing accuracy
Customer complaint resolution skills
MS Office proficiency
cvExpectations: Name hotels/ships worked at with star rating
Specify PMS systems used (Fidelio, Otalio, Opera, etc.)
List all languages with CEFR proficiency levels
Include cash handling or night audit experience
Note any cruise ship or hospitality management coursework
Highlight complaint resolution or VIP guest service examples
certifications: IATA (shore excursion or ticketing experience advantageous)
roles.languages: English (required, fluent); 2+ European languages required for Explora Journeys; Italian, German, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Mandarin noted as highly advantageous by Royal Caribbean

roles.summary: Cruise Staff animate the onboard experience — hosting trivia, pool games, sports tournaments, karaoke, and theme nights. They also assist during embarkation and special events. The role demands a naturally high-energy, outgoing personality, public speaking confidence, and often a second language.
experienceRequirements: Entertainment, hosting, or activities coordination background
Sports coaching or fitness instruction (advantageous)
Public speaking or performance experience
Ability to engage large and diverse audience groups
Customer service orientation
cvExpectations: Highlight performance, hosting, or entertainment experience
Note any sports qualifications (coaching badges, fitness certifications)
List languages spoken with proficiency
Include public speaking, MC, or theatre experience
Mention any cruise ship activity contracts
roles.languages: English (required); additional languages (Spanish, Italian, German, French) highly advantageous

roles.summary: Spa Therapists deliver a full menu of treatments — massage therapy, facials, body wraps, and beauty services — to paying guests aboard cruise ships. Onboard spas generate significant revenue, so therapists are also expected to upsell spa packages and products. The STCW suite of certificates is mandatory.
experienceRequirements: Minimum 2 years spa therapist experience
Qualified in massage therapy, facials, and body treatments
Retail sales and product upselling skills
Strong customer service and interpersonal skills
Cruise ship spa experience an advantage
Knowledge of wellness and holistic treatment philosophy
cvExpectations: List all spa therapy qualifications and awarding bodies
Note any specialist modalities (hot stone, sports massage, etc.)
Include product sales achievements or targets met
List cruise ship contracts if held (ship name + company)
Include all STCW certificates with issue dates
Note C1/D Visa and Seaman's Book validity dates
certifications: CIBTAC / CIDESCO / ITEC or equivalent beauty/therapy diploma
roles.languages: English (required); Spanish (required by MOBICACREW); additional languages advantageous

roles.summary: Laundry Attendants operate industrial laundry equipment to wash, dry, press, and distribute guest linen, crew uniforms, and towels. The role is physically demanding and requires strict adherence to public health and HACCP standards. Cruise experience is valued as ships have specialised linen logistics.
experienceRequirements: Laundry or linen services experience preferred
Operation of industrial washing and pressing equipment
Knowledge of HACCP and public health standards
Linen inventory management
Chemical handling and PPE compliance
Physical endurance for manual tasks
cvExpectations: List any laundry, housekeeping, or linen room experience
Note public health or HACCP training
Highlight cruise ship contracts if held
Mention physical fitness and ability to work long shifts
Include high school diploma or equivalent education
roles.languages: English (fluent required per Explora Journeys posting)

roles.summary: Night Stewards perform cabin cleaning, public area maintenance, and handle late-night guest requests during overnight hours when daytime housekeeping staff are off duty. The role is physically identical to Cabin Steward but operates exclusively during overnight shifts. Separate postings are rare — the role is often combined with Cabin Steward recruitment.
experienceRequirements: Prior cabin steward or hotel housekeeping experience
Ability and willingness to work overnight shifts
Physical stamina for consecutive overnight turns
Independent working ability with minimal supervision
Basic English communication for guest requests at night
cvExpectations: Highlight any overnight, night shift, or 24-hour operation experience
List housekeeping or cabin service experience with employers
Note STCW certificates held
Mention cruise ship experience if applicable

roles.summary: Storekeepers manage the hotel department's inventory of food, beverage, and non-food consumables — receiving deliveries, controlling storage conditions, processing requisitions, and conducting stocktakes. Cruise ship experience is commonly required as the logistics of provisioning a ship at sea require specialised knowledge.
experienceRequirements: Previous cruise ship storeroom or provisions experience (commonly required)
Inventory management and stock control systems (Navision, AMOS, or similar)
Receiving, storage, and issuing procedures
Computer and data entry skills
FIFO / stock rotation knowledge
Coordination with multiple departments (F&B, housekeeping, galley)
cvExpectations: Demonstrate cruise ship storeroom experience prominently
List inventory management software used
Include STCW certificate details
Note C1/D Visa and Seaman's Book status
Highlight any auditing or stocktaking experience
Include any logistics, supply chain, or purchasing experience
certifications: STCW Basic Safety Training (required — Windstar states this explicitly)
Food Safety / HACCP (for food provisions storage)
roles.languages: English (required for documentation and inter-department communication)

roles.summary: Onboard Photographers capture and sell photographs of guests during embarkation, onboard events, formal nights, and shore excursions. Strong DSLR technical skills are non-negotiable; equally important is a salesperson's mindset — revenue from photo sales is a tracked metric. Age requirement of 21+ is standard.
experienceRequirements: Minimum age 21
DSLR camera experience (manual settings essential)
Understanding of depth of field, aperture, focal length, shutter speed
Customer service and retail/photo sales experience
Outgoing, confident, and guest-engaging personality
Portrait and event photography skills
cvExpectations: Include photography qualifications, courses, or portfolio links
Specify camera systems used (Canon, Nikon, Sony) and focal lengths
Note any cruise ship or resort photography contracts
Highlight sales targets met or photo revenue achievements
Mention Photoshop or editing software proficiency
Include customer service or retail experience
certifications: STCW Basic Safety Training (required for shipboard boarding)
roles.languages: English (required); additional languages advantageous for guest interaction
